displayIdentity.body: A woman gives birth while a dragon waits. Her child is taken to God’s throne, and she flees into the wilderness. Michael and his angels fight the dragon and cast him out. The source names him as the old serpent, devil, Satan, deceiver, and accuser. Victory, a short time, pursuit, protection, a flood, the earth, and the woman’s offspring complete the vision.
displayIdentity.title: The dragon is named the old serpent, devil, Satan, deceiver, and accuser
